sys_script_include.description: Builds ADF page content using three strategies: (1) Template mode — fetches a Confluence template page and resolves ${placeholder} tokens with matching content block output or source record field values; (2) Content Blocks mode — assembles blocks sequentially into a full ADF document; (3) Provides buildBlockMap() for named block lookup used by template resolution. Supports block types: table, code, link, label, bullet_list, panel, status.
sys_script_include.name: ContentBuilder
